items.title: Soshi Subs Full Collection
items.description:
Soshi Subs was a forum active in fansubbing Girls' Generation Content that was airing on TV without official subtitles between 2007-2009.

Subbed Videos:

2006-03-27 - Super Junior Show - Yuri Cut
2007-07-19 - SNSD UCC - Hyoyeon
